## About
Truck and Car Shop is an auto parts store on N Batavia St in Orange. We carry parts for Chevrolet and GMC pickups, Ford trucks, fullsize Chevrolet, Chevy II and Nova, Chevelle and El Camino, Camaro and Ford Mustang.
Our shelves run from small hardware and wiring to gauges, lighting, horn caps and garage pieces like glass motor oil bottles. If you would rather order from home, you can request a catalog or call us.
We have a 4.3 rating from 856 Google reviews. We also have a sister store, Truck Shop, in Charlotte, NC.

## Services
- Chevrolet and GMC truck: Lighting, gauges, wiring, trim and small hardware for older Chevrolet and GMC pickups.
- Chevelle and El Camino: Parts and accessories for Chevelle and El Camino owners.
- Ford Mustang: Parts and accessories for Ford Mustang owners.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer free shipping?
A: Yes, shipping is free on orders over $350. Restrictions apply, so give us a call for the details.

Q: What is it like on a busy weekend?
A: Weekends can get crowded and the lot can fill up, so plan to stay a while. One reviewer pointed out that you pull a number, so you know where you stand in line.

Q: Can I get a catalog?
A: Yes. You can request a printed catalog or browse the digital catalogs on our site.
